page-door-atrium: A pencil drawing of a small open arched doorway built from wooden blocks, with a keystone at the top, a brass microscope beside it and a stack of three books in front.
page-door-porch: A pencil drawing of a small porch lantern with a candle inside and a ring on top, a potted plant with round leaves beside it, and a folded letter with a few lines of writing on the table.
page-door-faith: A pencil drawing of a row of old closed books of different sizes standing on a wooden stand, the last one leaning, with a rolled scroll on the table in front and a clay oil lamp with a small flame beside them.
